csv_scope_of_work: This Project is primarily a sidewalk infill project intended to construct missing sidewalk segments and improve pedestrian connectivity within three community neighborhoods in the City of Escondido. Professional engineering design services shall include, but not be limited to, right-of-way surveying and base mapping, preparation of a drainage study (optional task), preparation of 30%, 60%, and 90% design plans, and the development of a complete, bid-ready Plans, Specifications, and Estimates (PS&E) package.
